scientific_integrity: Explicit acyclic discrete Morse certificate; exact integer attaching-degree minor; separate complete mod-two chain rank check. No reliance on an unverified numerical extrapolation.
scientific_limitations: Complete finite, computer-assisted proof for the perfect-matching subcomplex of GP(8,3); does not classify arbitrary generalized Petersen graphs, equivariant homotopy, or inclusion maps. Absolute bibliographic uniqueness is not asserted.
title: Integral mixed-dimensional homotopy of the Möbius–Kantor perfect-matching complex
